html:
UE 5.6 alpha.9 — React editor tab

Implementation

  • Replaces the plain Slate form with a reference-inspired responsive panel for Bridge Status, Project, Unreal/Blender Handoff, Blender Connection, Export Settings, both transfer directions, and Transfer Status.
  • Uses React 19.3, ReactDOM 19.3, and Vite 8.1 for a reproducible production bundle. The bundle lives under plugin Resources/ReactUI and loads from the engine plugin folder; no remote UI assets or services are used.
  • Keeps authentication, connection state, and the transfer worker in native C++. The reflected browser bridge exposes bounded state and an allowlist of actions. Transfers still use the existing preview and explicit confirmation before apply.
  • Preserves the Unreal source asset name when the optional Blender name override is blank, and retains /Game/Content/Returns/ as the Unreal import path.
  • Enables UE 5.6's bundled WebBrowserWidget dependency for the editor tab.

Validation

  • React production build completed with Vite 8.1.0.
  • UE 5.6.1 Development Editor plugin compile and isolated full editor-target build passed (29 UBT actions).
  • Alpha.9 package clean-project load, live plugin health, and stdio MCP Unreal session/project identity checks passed. The package verifier now checks the explicitly selected Unreal session separately because forge_ensure_connected reports overall failure when Blender is absent, even when Unreal is healthy.
  • Package SHA256: ed70f321cdb2664049d7d692056e10deebf3b316126faf0b37220719cd32156b.
  • The initial split-file bundle rendered white in Unreal's local-file WebBrowser. The corrected single-file UI bundle and its verification are recorded in the alpha.9 white-tab fix.
